comment: 2026acna | Review override: Recover the first missed DECam griz epoch for the user's explicitly approved first-epoch programme. October 1 WiFeS says a few days after maximum, yielding only an approximate lower age constraint near the +30-day boundary (frame assumption retained); SALT peak timing is weak, not a precise fitted cutoff. No actual DEBASS qcinv is established; previous dated JSONs preserve the separate +7-day planned-target eligibility. A single epoch anchors late-time flux and checks the classification/phase interpretation. Do not mislabel detection age as phase or bypass a newly reliable expiry/subtype/terminal decision.
